A Sikh-owned restaurant in West London faces protests after owner Harman Singh Kapoor refused to serve halal meat, displaying a 'Proudly Non-Halal' sign. Hundreds demanded its closure, sparking debate over religious freedom and free speech. What is behind the controversy, and where does John Cleese fit in? Gursshheen Gahllen reports for Firstpost America.
